description: This file defines an abstract class 'LudoRulesEngine' that encapsulates the core game logic for a classic Ludo game. It includes methods for determining legal moves, applying moves immutably, ending turns, and handling movement rules, capturing, and win conditions. The class is intended as a rules engine to be used within a larger Ludo game application, separating game rules from UI or other layers.

classes.name: LudoRulesEngine
classes.description: An abstract final class providing static methods for game rule logic for Ludo, including move validation, move application, turn management, and win condition detection.

methods.name: legalMoves
methods.description: Computes all legal moves for the current player given the dice roll, based on game state and movement rules.

methods.name: applyMove
methods.description: Applies a specified move to the game state immutably, handling capture, progression, and win detection.

methods.name: endTurnIfNeeded
methods.description: Advances turn to the next player if no extra roll is pending, updating game state accordingly.
